description: The writers' lounge: two sofas that don't match, a coffee urn, and a whiteboard of tonight's games with the scores rubbed out and written in again. The stat sheets are pinned up by club, and somebody has circled every Golden Goose fixture in red. The studio is through the east door.

window.description: Full-height glass onto the lot: the swept court, the gatehouse at the gate and the red lamp over the stage door.
window.name: the lot window

name: KSAB5 Writers' Lounge
